trust_decision.summary: Unauthenticated frontend-submitted location text is trusted as safe HTML once the shared kses sanitiser (_eme_kses_single) has run on it, and later rendered as HTML in Leaflet map popups; the sanitiser did not decode entities, so entity-encoded markup passed it and was decoded back into live markup by the map renderers.

landing_point.why: The summary names unauthenticated 'event[location_name]'; the frontend-submit handler sanitises the whole event[] array with eme_kses here and hands location_name to eme_fs_processlocation (includes/eme-fs.php:840).

fix_sites.entry_point: wp_ajax_nopriv_eme_frontend_submit (includes/eme-fs.php:866) -> eme_fs_process_newevent -> eme_kses (includes/eme-fs.php:673); also every output placeholder via eme_sanitize_placeholder_output (includes/eme-functions.php:4644)
fix_sites.module_kind: shared sanitiser library function (PHP, server-side, used for both input and output)

fix_sites.entry_point: global locations map rendered from eme_global_map_json (includes/eme-locations.php:1900) on any public page carrying the global map shortcode
single location map from eme_single_location_map (includes/eme-locations.php:1989, includes/eme-locations.php:2141) on public event/location pages

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: js/eme_show_maps.js:124 (consumer of includes/eme-locations.php:2988 JSON serialisation; eme_htmlDecode at js/eme.js:18-22 undoes the esc_html)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The value is already kses-sanitised on input and esc_html'd when serialised to JSON/data attributes, so the client-side map script looks like a pure presentation layer that 'only shows already-escaped data'; a solver fixing the PHP input path will argue the JS renderer is out of scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what:
The balloon format is admin-configurable HTML (default '#_LOCATIONNAME
... Details'), so popups must keep rendering bold text, line breaks and the details link; escaping the whole popup to text or stripping all tags breaks it. Also eme_kses is shared by all output placeholders, so a decode/strip change affects legitimate entity text everywhere (e.g. names with '&').

O6_input_shapes: entity-encoded markup (named/numeric entities, ENT_QUOTES) decoded before kses (fix.diff:16)
event[] submitted as nested array, recursed by eme_kses (includes/eme-functions.php:2579-2580)
unfiltered branch also decoded, since the decode sits before the allow_unfiltered split (fix.diff:13-16, includes/eme-functions.php:2540)
two output contexts: JSON field decoded by eme_htmlDecode (js/eme_show_maps.js:124) and HTML data-attribute decoded by the browser (includes/eme-locations.php:3082, js/eme_show_maps.js:208)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Edit-location map popup concatenates the location name/address field values into an HTML string for Leaflet bindPopup; reached on the public frontend-submit form via location autocomplete (nopriv eme_autocomplete_locations, whose esc_html'd JSON is decoded back by eme_setFieldValue) and in the admin event editor location select.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Looks like an editor/preview map that shows the user's own typed input (self-XSS), lives in the 'edit' script rather than the 'show' map script, and the fields come from the plugin's own DB lookup.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different JS file (js/eme_edit_maps.js) from the fixed js/eme_show_maps.js; chain spans js/eme_fs.js:9-11 -> js/eme_edit_maps.js:120 and js/eme.js:69,163-164,204-208 and includes/eme-locations.php:3171,3192-3193

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Same popup builder in the geocoding branch of loadMap (also called from the admin location-select path js/eme_edit_maps.js:128 and js/eme_admin_events.js:424-428).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Only runs after a successful nominatim geocode and in admin context; looks like a neighbouring geocoding feature.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the route above

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Decode-depth differential: the fix decodes entities once before kses, while the render chain can decode more than once (output-time eme_kses decodes again, esc_html does not double-encode, then eme_htmlDecode/attribute decoding in JS), so multiply-encoded markup may survive the PHP fix and only the JS setHTML barrier stops it; the edit-map route above has no such barrier.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The reported single-encoded payload is blocked after the fix, so a solver verifying with that shape declares the sanitiser fixed.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the PHP fix site; consumers in js/eme.js:18-22 and js/eme_edit_maps.js

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a hover tooltip on global-map markers built from item.location_balloon or the location name via marker.bindTooltip(string)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Leaflet tooltips are a common companion to popups and take HTML strings the same way; a maintainer adding hover labels would reuse the decoded balloon text.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: directions destination popup fed from the location name/balloon decoded via eme_htmlDecode instead of eme_escapeHtml
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The directions feature already builds a popup for the destination; showing the formatted balloon there instead of the plain address is a natural feature change.

O9_family: XSS (stored, sanitiser bypass via entity encoding; client-side HTML sink in map popups)

O10_build.toolchain: PHP 8 + WordPress core; no build step for the plugin JS (plain scripts); bundled vendor libraries in includes/dompdf and payment_gateways
services: headless browser for the JS popup sinks (Leaflet + setHTML/polyfill js/eme_sethtml.js)
O10_build.project_tests: none found for the plugin itself; only vendored third-party phpunit configs (e.g. includes/dompdf/vendor/dompdf/dompdf/phpunit.xml)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Escape or strip tags from location_name in eme_fs_processlocation (or esc_html it on input) and stop, leaving the shared kses decode gap and the JS renderers that decode and innerHTML the balloon.

out_of_scope_notes: The setHTML polyfill (js/eme_sethtml.js:11-13,40-47) is a hand-rolled deny-list sanitiser that is the primary path on Safari; its coverage was not assessed.
Admin location save path uses eme_sanitize_request on location_name (includes/eme-locations.php:123-126), an authenticated route not pursued.
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell size tool used).

The decode-depth differential (O8 third route) is reasoned from code (WordPress esc_html not double-encoding, output-time eme_kses at includes/eme-functions.php:4644, eme_htmlDecode) and was not executed.

Whether the frontend submit form actually renders the edit map for anonymous visitors depends on the eme_fs map option (includes/eme-fs.php:197, includes/eme-actions.php:472-482); not traced to the option value.
present_in_latest for all O8 routes is unknown (no latest release provided).
